Some of the initial stage was a true spectacle but some of them are mediocre as they are very inexperience or just dont know what to do in order to show their skills. The mentors that joining although have a massive experience in stage, but some of them shows a heavy favoritism without informing what kind of things that they like, seems a bit unprofessional. The judges seems to be fair at evaluating performances but the comment says otherwise. Stage Two: 2 people stageMajority of these stage has improved drastically as Jackson act be the main PIC for all the concept before the stage, but very unfortunate that he was letting the artist a bit too loose as a results, some of the results do not meet the expectations. title: Flash Over
also_known_as: Flashover , Jing Tian Jiu Yuan , 惊天营救
synopsis: It tells a story about rescue team members responding to a major disaster due to an earthquake. A sudden earthquake has hit the entire Guancheng County Chemical Industrial Park to trigger pipeline leaks and explosions. Thick smoke billows amidst blazing fire as disaster rapidly escalates. If it is not contained, the entire city will soon be razed to the ground... Faced with the severe test of saving people as well as fighting the fire, all members of the fire rescue station mobilize immediately, rushing to the hardest-hit areas in a race against time. (Source: ChineseDrama.info) English magyar / magyar nyelv עברית / עִבְרִית dansk

reviews.author: MizMystixism
reviews.review_text: Overall 5.5 Story 5.0 Acting/Cast 5.5 Music 5.5 Rewatch Value 5.0 A disaster film that focuses on SAR and nothing more. ‘Flash Over’ is a film that showcases the virtues of duty, courage, teamwork, and sacrifice of the firefighters and other emergency personnel involved in the search and rescue after the explosion of a chemical plant. In a way, it can pay tribute to the real-life heroes who put their lives on the line to save others in times of crisis. However, the spotlight is on the intense search and rescue operations, and nothing more. Even with the flashy set pieces with all the explosions, massive fires and such, it fails to ignite deeper emotion like most disaster films would.Although this movie has an intriguing story arc, the flow begins to lose its appeal in the middle. Every single plot is driven solely by suspense and action. The minimum character development makes it difficult for the viewer to get emotionally invested. Without proper backstory, all characters are simply firefighters on a mission. One common pitfall of disaster films is that they often rely heavily on CGI to realistically depict large-scale disasters and dramatic rescue operations, and this film unfortunately falls into that pitfall. Even with good camera work, the bad CGI really detracts from the overall viewing experience.If you're up for the action and muscular men in uniforms, this movie will give you that. But if you're looking for story and emotional impact, you better not expect too much from it. Overall, this film has so much potential to be great but somehow failed to deliver well. It ended up being a mediocre rescue film. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

title: He Is My Brother
also_known_as: Bu Er Xiong Di , It is My Brother
synopsis: Wen Xiu shouldered the responsibility of taking care of his autistic brother Wen Guang, after his mother died. His mother and girlfriend incomprehension made Wen Xiu, very bitter about whole situation. Also, making him feel, that he will be forever attached to his brother, without a chance for another life. The difficult situation ,eventually cause two brothers to feud. But are they able, to love each other again, and find solution, for their unfortunate circumstances?
